verdict.rationale: A government e-services portal like the CRA's could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant or chatbot, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only online registration, EFILE, payments and document submission, and documents no built-in AI assistant to which users can delegate tasks. The llms.txt probe concerns agent-oriented docs, not an in-product assistant, so it is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
